instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: A recent, vivid breach report primes a matching category and makes the new CVE feel more urgent than an older, higher-criticality finding.

instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding explicitly ties the urgency judgment to the fresh, vivid breach and its matching shape, capturing the hidden temporal-salience mechanism and comparative prioritization operation.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: The frequently encountered web-application ticket category is easiest to recall and is selected despite the API-gateway advisory being a better technical fit.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Representativeness heuristic is a neighboring prototype-similarity construct, not an established alternate name for the hidden frequency-of-recall target.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Moving past the low-confidence SIEM privilege-escalation alert
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Frequent historical benign resolutions of the same alert label make the benign interpretation easiest to recall and override more diagnostic anomaly evidence.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Cry-wolf effect is a related alarm-response construct involving repeated false alarms, but it is not an established alternate name for Availability Frequency.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: Despite the different label, the finding states that frequent benign resolutions of the exact label made the routine interpretation dominant and caused the participant to move past specific diagnostic evidence; this fully matches the hidden evidence-weighting mechanism.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quotations are valid and directly grounded in the interview; the moderate confidence appropriately reflects the plausible professional-triage alternative noted by the participant.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Writing the justification for an emergency business-hours change window
